rejected.issue: One historical Moon event and Earthrise dominated nearly every practical unit.
rejected.decision: Use separate real artifacts for communication (Library of Congress), information (Smithsonian reports), learning (actual public-domain text), planning (NASA host guide), and creative work (Met public-domain art). Keep a stable artifact within a unit so a novice can focus on a new judgement, not relearn all facts.

rejected.issue: Drafts used bare URLs and repeated source disclaimers instead of teaching.
rejected.decision: Regenerate per lesson with proper links, a real observable task and compact scoped source labels. Reject evidence-only introductions and unverifiable AI performance claims.
